method: HSBC Saudi Arabia's asset management, margin lending and retail brokerage business lines were acquired by SAB Invest on 15 Sep 2022 for SAR 1,216.8m (12.6% of FY2022 TOI, so the immateriality exemption does not apply). Management estimates the business lines' operating income at SAR 233m for full-year 2022 had they been owned from 1 Jan 2022. FY2023 income for the days not owned in FY2022 (1 Jan-14 Sep = 257 days): 233 x 257/365 = SAR 164.1m (E) = +1.7 pp of FY2022 TOI.
assumptions: SAR 233m read as the acquired lines' own full-year operating income (group TOI was SAR 9.65bn); 2023 run-rate equal to the 2022 pro-forma; income accrues evenly. Post-acquisition contribution is not disclosed.
notes: Flag E. Reported TOI growth 31.7%; organic 31.1% after A-1060-01 and A-1060-02.

method: FY2022 TOI includes a bargain-purchase gain on the same acquisition (other operating income), restated from SAR 155.4m to SAR 108.6m when the purchase price allocation was completed; it does not recur in FY2023. = -1.1 pp of FY2022 TOI.
notes: FY2022 TOI used is the restated 9,650.2 (originally 9,697.0; restatement table p.95).
